name: Attention Aggregation for 3D Points
definition: Aggregates unordered, variable-sized sets of retrieved pixel features from multiple input views into a single unique feature vector for a query 3D point, handling visual occlusions and arbitrary input counts.
summary: Attention Aggregation for 3D Points aggregates multi-view pixel features into a single vector by learning weights based on visual consistency and distance, handling occlusions and arbitrary view counts better than simple mean pooling.
